definitions.explanation: A system of faith and worship; belief in a god or gods.

examples.japanese: {日本人|にほんじん}の{多|おお}くは{特定|とくてい}の{宗教|しゅうきょう}を{持|も}たない。
examples.english: Many Japanese people don't follow a specific religion.

examples.japanese: {宗教|しゅうきょう}の{自由|じゆう}は{憲法|けんぽう}で{保障|ほしょう}されている。
examples.english: Freedom of religion is guaranteed by the constitution.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{宗教|しゅうきょう}の{話題|わだい}には{触|ふ}れないようにしている。{政治|せいじ}と{宗教|しゅうきょう}は、{人|ひと}によって{考|かんが}え{方|かた}が{大|おお}きく{違|ちが}うからだ。
examples.english: He avoids the topic of religion. That's because people's views differ greatly on politics and religion.

notes:
{宗教|しゅうきょう} refers to religion as a system of belief and practice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宗教|しゅうきょう}の{自由|じゆう} (freedom of religion)
- {宗教|しゅうきょう}{法人|ほうじん} (religious corporation)
- {宗教|しゅうきょう}{団体|だんたい} (religious organization)
- {宗教|しゅうきょう}{戦争|せんそう} (religious war)
- {宗教|しゅうきょう}{心|しん} (religiosity, religious feeling)
- {宗教|しゅうきょう}{家|か} (religious person, clergyman)

MAJOR RELIGIONS:
- キリスト{教|きょう} (Christianity)
- {仏教|ぶっきょう} (Buddhism)
- イスラム{教|きょう} (Islam)
- {神道|しんとう} (Shinto)
- ヒンドゥー{教|きょう} (Hinduism)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, many people practice elements of both Shinto and Buddhism without identifying strongly with either, a phenomenon called {神仏|しんぶつ}{習合|しゅうごう}.
